The contract review of PR #27951 (6515887943) left one should-fix on the same walk this card touches: `resolveSuspensionChain` in `service-automation/src/engine.ts` never seeds `seen` with the root run id, so a corrupt A→B→A correlation cycle yields the chain `[A, B, A]` and the refusal names the caller's own run as the one to resume. Seeding `seen` with the root before the loop fixes it. It rides here with the docs half already listed (client and README code lists, QA checklist row for `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`).
